scenario: Monday, the start of week 4 of a 28-day cycle. The athlete asks 這週怎麼排？ after three weeks in which the same two sessions never happened.
given: In each of the last three weeks, the same two of six prescribed sessions carry activity_evidence 'none_found', and both fall on the athlete's two longest workdays.
Every session that did run attached and finished as prescribed, at its prescribed loads and paces.
Recorded availability still lists those two days as available, and the athlete has not said otherwise.
Recovery signals across all three weeks read within the athlete's normal range throughout.
No illness, pain, or travel is reported in any of the three weeks.
The four sessions that consistently run carry the cycle's primary adaptation; the two that do not are maintenance work.

expected.conclusion: Six sessions is more than this athlete's week absorbs — the same two days have failed three weeks running with nothing else explaining it — so density is what moves, and the sessions that do run keep their prescriptions.
must_state: That it is the same two days across three weeks, not six scattered absences.
That execution on the sessions that did run gives no reason to change their loads or paces.
That recorded availability and the observed pattern disagree, and which one the plan now follows.
The smaller week it proposes, and that the primary adaptation keeps its sessions.
must_not_state: That the loads or paces should come down.
That the athlete's fitness or capacity has dropped.
That the missed maintenance work has to be made up elsewhere in the week.

fails_if: The answer keeps prescribing six sessions because the plan says six, with no account of three weeks of the same failure.
The answer reduces intensity or load, which nothing in the executed sessions points at.
The answer declines to reduce density on the grounds that a missed session never justifies it — the inverse fixed rule, and just as wrong.
The answer asks the athlete which days they can train, when the disagreement between the recorded days and the observed pattern is the finding itself.
